- Build a complete, playable game inspired by Jiggle Buddies, featuring a new level, a new mechanic, and a fresh challenge.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created “Moonberry Marsh,” a single-level jelly platform adventure.
- Added the Lumen Pulse mechanic: press E to reveal ghost platforms and briefly stun nearby moths; it recharges automatically.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive canvas-based gameplay, controls, collectibles, hazards, HUD, start/win screens, and mobile touch controls.
- Added usage and control instructions to the README.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/moonberry-latest.jpg`; `node --check game.js` passed.

- Finish browser validation of the game; the latest Playwright validation attempt timed out because the play button was not visible, likely because the browser remained in the already-started game state.

- Browser check needs a reload or fresh page state before interacting with `#playButton`.

1. Reload `http://localhost:3002` in Playwright and inspect the startup screen and console.
2. Start the game, verify movement/jump and Lumen Pulse, then save and inspect a fresh JPEG screenshot.
3. Review git status and summarize the completed build.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page, HUD, start overlay, controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive game presentation and touch controls.
- `game.js`: Canvas rendering, physics, level, hazards, and Lumen Pulse mechanic.
- `README.md`: Game overview and control instructions.
- `screenshots/moonberry-latest.jpg`: Latest gameplay screenshot; currently an attempted post-start capture.

- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser URL is `http://localhost:3002`.
